name: Strata
description: Strata is an open source inference engine for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and other large MoE models, with a Strix Halo (gfx1151) HIP engine, MTP drafting and an OpenAI-compatible API. The script installs the Strata Terminal, which downloads the signed engine for the GPU with its own HIP runtime, and serves ISTA-DASLab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder by default.

notes.text: Strata's Strix Halo support is experimental upstream. The container needs /dev/kfd and /dev/dri passed through, which the script sets up when GPU passthrough is enabled.
The install runs Strata's official Terminal installer from its GitHub release and asks before it does. Set var_external_installer=yes for unattended installs.
The first start downloads the engine and ISTA-DASLab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder IQ1_M (about 58 GB) and prepares it. Follow it with: journalctl -fu strata
The API needs a key. Show it from inside the container with: strata launch --show-key
Change the model or launch options in /opt/strata/strata.env, then run: systemctl restart strata
Strata counts free memory from inside the container, so give it enough RAM for the model: the Coder needs about 32 GB, the full IQ3_S about 62 GB.
